get_cache_settings: get cache configuration and available settings from the database with current values and field metadata
test_cache_connection: test a Redis cache connection with provided credentials and return success or failure status
update_cache_settings: save encrypted cache settings to the database and reinitialize the cache with new parameters
init_cache_settings_in_db: initialize cache settings from the database on startup and only reinitialize if parameters have changed
cache_params_equal: compare two cache parameter dictionaries for equality while normalizing values and filtering UI-only fields
